title: ¿Qué tal el fin de semana?
setting: Es lunes. Emma te escribe para saber qué tal tu fin de semana.

says.t: Good morning, Yolanda! How was your weekend?
says.es: ¡Buenos días, Yolanda! ¿Qué tal el fin de semana?

options.feedback: Con it usamos was: It was lovely.
Hablas del fin de semana pasado: It was lovely.

options.t: No, I wasn't. I was at the beach.
No, I weren't. I was at the beach.
No, I didn't. I was at the beach.
options.feedback: La pregunta es con were, así que la respuesta es con was: No, I wasn't.

options.t: Yes, it was. It was very hot!
Yes, it was. It was very hotter!

says.t: Lucky you! Were your grandchildren with you?

options.t: Yes, they were. They were very happy.
Yes, they was. They was very happy.
options.feedback: Con they siempre were: they were.

says.t: Lovely. My weekend was very quiet. I was ill.
says.es: Qué bonito. Mi fin de semana fue muy tranquilo. Estuve mala.

options.t: Oh no! Are you better now?
Oh no! Are you more good now?
I'm glad! See you soon, Emma.
I'm glad! You was very brave.
